turns.interviewer_utterance: What are the primary operational goals and core capabilities this system must deliver for configuring the correlator, monitoring system health, and processing the data stream in real time?
turns.interviewee_utterance:
The main goal is to let operations staff set up the correlator for an observing run, verify that it is behaving correctly, and keep the data flowing without interruption. It also needs to take the raw correlator output, transform it into a usable form in real time, and hand it off for storage and later analysis.
On the monitoring side, people need a clear view of system health, current observing status, and the quality of the incoming data so they can spot issues quickly. Where possible, the system should detect faults on its own and recover automatically, since we can’t afford to lose data during an observation if we can avoid it.
